teaser.en: Builders cut poles from it, though its Digo name, 'termite crawler', warns that the termites will soon follow.
teaser.sw: Wajenzi hukata nguzo kutoka kwake, ingawa jina lake la Kidigo, 'kinachotambaliwa na mchwa', linaonya kwamba mchwa watafuata hivi karibuni.
teaser.dg: Atu anaodzenga nkutema nguzo kpwenye muhi uhu, ela dzinare ra Chidigo, *mwambala lutswa*, rinaonya kukala malutswa gandalunga.

summary.en: *Mwambala lutswa* is an understorey shrub of the coastal forest with spiny, holly-like leaves. It is cut for building poles, but its name warns that termites favour them.
summary.sw: *Mwambala lutswa* ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa ya msitu wa pwani, chenye majani yenye miiba yanayofanana na ya *holly*. Hukatwa kwa ajili ya nguzo za kujengea, lakini jina lake linaonya kwamba mchwa huzipenda nguzo hizo.
summary.dg: *Mwambala lutswa* ni chitsaka chinachomera photsi ya mihi mikulu kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, chenye makodza genye miya dza ga *holly*. Nkutemwa kuhenda nguzo za kudzengera, ela dzinare rinaonya kukala malutswa ganazimendza nguzo hizo.

about.en: *Mwambala lutswa* is a shrub with stiff leaves whose edges carry spiny teeth, much like holly. It belongs to the violet family, though it looks nothing like a garden violet.
about.sw: *Mwambala lutswa* ni kichaka chenye majani magumu ambayo kingo zake zina meno ya miiba, kama ya *holly*. Ni wa familia ya *violet*, ingawa haufanani hata kidogo na *violet* ya bustanini.
about.dg: *Mwambala lutswa* ni chitsaka chenye makodza magumu genye meno ga miya kanda-kanda, dza *holly*. Ni wa jamii ya *violet*, ela tauhalana kabisa na *violet* ya busitani.

where.en: It grows in the shady understorey of coastal forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika kivuli chini ya miti mikubwa ya msitu wa pwani.
where.dg: Unamera photsi ya mihi mikulu, phatu phenye pepho, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: Its stems are used as building poles.
uses.sw: Mashina yake hutumika kama nguzo za kujengea.
uses.dg: Mihiye nkuhumirwa dza nguzo za kudzengera.

culture.en: The name means 'termite crawler', because termites favour poles made from it. It is a name that carries practical building advice.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kinachotambaliwa na mchwa', kwa sababu mchwa hupenda nguzo zilizotengenezwa kwa mmea huu. Ni jina lenye ushauri wa vitendo kuhusu ujenzi.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaoambalwa ni malutswa', kpwa sababu malutswa ganamendza nguzo zinazotemwa kpwenye muhi uhu. Ni dzina renye shauri ra kazi ya kudzenga.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwambala lutswa*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Rinorea ilicifolia*, after its holly-like (*Ilex*) leaves.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwambala lutswa*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Rinorea ilicifolia*, kutokana na majani yake yanayofanana na ya *holly* (*Ilex*).
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwambala lutswa*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Rinorea ilicifolia*, kpwa sababu makodzage ganahalana na ga *holly* (*Ilex*).

reason.en: Spiny terminalia, valued instead for termite-resistant poles
reason.sw: Mwangati, ambao badala yake huthaminiwa kwa nguzo zisizoliwa na mchwa
reason.dg: *Mwanga kululu*, unaotogolwa badala yakpwe kpwa nguzo zisizoriwa ni malutswa.

reason.en: Another shrub cut for building poles
reason.sw: Mnembenembe, kichaka kingine kinachokatwa kwa nguzo za kujengea
reason.dg: *Mkalakala*, chitsaka chanjina chinachotemwa kuhenda nguzo za kudzengera.

reason.en: Another plant pole cutters think twice about
reason.sw: Mviru, mmea mwingine ambao wakataji nguzo huufikiria mara mbili
reason.dg: *Mviru*, mmea wanjina ambao atu anaotema nguzo nkuuhepa.
